picks.reasoning: Josedeodo is the kind of jungler who decides a single game, and I'd take him over anything CFO has on the map, however loud their highlight reel gets. Their comeback-and-throw history is noise I won't chase, so I'm backing the player, not the hype.

Tempo is the whole story here: TLAW owns first tower and dragon, and they convert every lead they get at 15, while CFO is trading even at the same mark and losing the dragon fights. Josedeodo's early pathing gives TLAW the map control to stop CFO's comeback attempts before they start.

Fearless drafts reward the team with more keys in its pocket, and TLAW's bans-proof pool across Ahri, Orianna, Syndra, Pantheon, Qiyana and Lucian gives them a counter for almost any board CFO can construct. Their star form is also running hotter, and a team that has converted every lead it's held at fifteen is hard to beat when the draft is already in its favor.

Over 20 games TLAW holds a +1.1k gold edge at 15 and has converted all 9 of its leads, while CFO sits slightly behind at 15 and has taken only 35% of dragon-fights first. That's a steady early-game profile against a team that has been more volatile, so I'm leaning TLAW without overreaching on one game.

Warm rooms win these, and TLAW has the calm, settled feel of a group that trusts each other, while CFO's sharp swings look like a team whose nerves rise and fall with the scoreboard. When a team keeps handing back leads, the mood around it matters more than the draft, so I'm backing TLAW to keep their heads when the game gets tight.
